thread:
harper_cs: Pulled the ThunderCrest vendor risk form back in. Their security team wants three things: (1) confirmation of BYOK for embeddings, (2) a retention guarantee for vectors (30 days), and (3) a SOC2 excerpt that lists processing regions. They said they won't move forward on renewal until BYOK is confirmed.

ben_se: Quick status: BYOK is available on Dedicated and Private only. Hosted API uses provider-managed keys today.

harper_cs: Can we give them a short, non-technical statement to pass to their legal/security folks?

meera_security: Suggested wording: "Redwood supports customer-managed encryption keys (BYOK) on Redwood Dedicated and Redwood Private deployments. Our Hosted API uses provider-managed keys; we can discuss contractual retention commitments for Hosted on a case-by-case basis. Full SOC2 reports are available under NDA; a redacted regions exhibit is attached."

noel_success_eng: For proof of deletion they asked for: we can export a redacted audit sample from Dedicated showing a vector deletion event with a deletion timestamp and key id (redacted). For Hosted we can offer deletion timestamps but we cannot provide per-customer KMS key ids because keys are provider-managed.

niya_legal: Legal note: We can offer a DPA amendment for Hosted that commits to a 30-day retention for embeddings and the types of evidence we will provide (deletion timestamp, audit export). BYOK however is a product capability and must be scoped to Dedicated/Private or a funded roadmap change. I can draft an addendum that enumerates evidence types and caveats.

cs-bot: New ticket created: CS-6347 - "ThunderCrest vendor form: BYOK / 30d retention" (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-6347)

harper_cs: Actions: 1) ben_se - attach meera's wording + redacted SOC2 regions PDF to the customer reply. 2) noel_success_eng - prepare a redacted Dedicated audit sample and a 1-pager on architecture + timeline by tomorrow. 3) niya_legal - draft Hosted retention DPA addendum and post to CS-6347. 4) I'll set account health to 'watch' and mark renewal as 'at-risk/conditional'.

ben_se: Sending now. Reply to customer: "Thanks for the questionnaire. Attaching a redacted SOC2 regions excerpt and a summary of our BYOK and retention support. BYOK is available on Dedicated/Private; Hosted uses provider-managed keys. If BYOK is mandatory, we recommend a short scoping call to discuss Dedicated and timelines. Please share availability for a 30-minute call this week." :mag:

noel_success_eng: I'll have the audit snippet and the one-pager by EOD tomorrow. It will include a sample delete event (event_id redacted, timestamp, redacted key id) and notes on contractual proof types.

niya_legal: Drafting addendum now. Will include explicit language that BYOK is limited to Dedicated/Private and the evidence we will supply for Hosted retention. Posting to CS-6347 when ready.

harper_cs: Thanks all. I'll paste the customer's response here once they reply.

meera_security: Internal note: product roadmap lists BYOK for Dedicated as coming next quarter; Hosted BYOK is not planned. If they push for Hosted parity, escalate to PL to discuss acceleration costs.
